gate: Spirit is the actual source of supply here, not the bank account, not the praise from a room, not the food on the table. A person carrying this code moves through life on a slow weather pattern. The mood swings up into a fullness that feels like the world is feeding them straight from source, then it swings down into a hollow where nothing tastes of anything and they are sure something is wrong with them. The wave is the teaching, not a malfunction inside it. The hollow is not a depression to be cured, it is the trough of the same wave whose crest was joy a week earlier. Most people mistake this rhythm for moodiness or instability. The carrier often mistakes it for that too, and tries to flatten the wave into something more presentable. Flattened, the code loses its information. Ridden, it teaches that abundance is felt, not held.
centre_field: This drive is wired to the part of you that runs on a tide, pumping feeling out and reading feeling in at the same time. That double nature is the whole teaching. The wave here is not a reaction to what happened that morning, it is this part's native motion, on and off across days the way breath goes in and out across seconds. When the tide is up, the code reads as fullness, generosity, a sense that life is plenty. When it is down, the same body reads scarcity, dryness, a quiet conviction that the well has gone empty. Nothing in the world has actually changed. The inner weather has moved through its own arc. Carrying this means living inside that arc and learning that clarity arrives at the end of the wave, not in the middle of one of its swings.
channel: Felt on its own, this weather stays private. The carrier feels the abundance and the hollow with no built-in way to make any of it useful to another person. What this code reaches for is a provocation, the kind of edged poke that pushes against a stuck place in someone else and asks them to feel something they have been numbing. The lineage calls this connection the channel of emoting, a current that carries feeling out as something a room can actually catch. Without the poke, the wave just rolls through one body and out again, beautiful and unread. With it, mood becomes message. The fullness wakes others to spirit, and the hollow wakes them to what they have been pretending about supply. Joined, the weather lands. Alone, this code is a storm passing over an empty field, lit up inside and unnoticed from outside.
